name: provident-electron
description: Prebuilt Electron shell for apps using the Provident SSR framework (provident-ssr) — full synthetic-event access + rendered-HTML visibility for MCP endpoints, for agentic use and debugging exposure.

scripts.build: npm run clean && esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/main/main.cjs && esbuild src/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/main/preload.cjs && esbuild src/main/standalone.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/main/standalone.mjs && esbuild src/main/battery-host.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/main/battery-host.mjs && esbuild src/renderer/renderer.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outdir=dist/renderer && cp src/renderer/index.html dist/renderer/index.html
scripts.build:watch: esbuild src/main/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/main/main.cjs --watch & esbuild src/main/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist/main/preload.cjs --watch & esbuild src/renderer/renderer.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --outdir=dist/renderer --watch
